target.description:
Represents the {@link Persistable} type linked to this source collection
on which fetch operation is performed to preview the target data.

status.description: The status of a {@link FileSourceCollection} created through FileUpload flow

config.description: The configuration of the source collection.

dataIssue.description: List of data issues associated with the source collection.

cdcConfig.description:
CDC configuration extracted from the source collection.
Contains enabled status, tracking column, and schedule.
Only available for SqlSourceCollection, null for other types.

title: Cached information about a {@link SourceCollection} for quick lookup for use in the UI.
